data.value: DispHub is open source under the GNU General Public License v3.0. It stores everything on your PC and sends no telemetry.

data.name: About_Note1
data.value: Hi, I'm Quinten. I built DispHub because I kept opening three different control panels just to make a game look right or to make my screen easier on the eyes at night. I wanted one small, quiet app that does it properly and looks like it belongs on Windows.

data.name: About_Note2
data.value: DispHub is made by one person, in spare time, with a lot of care. If it makes your screen a little nicer to look at, that means a lot. Ideas and bug reports are always welcome on GitHub; I read every one.

data.name: About_NoteSignature
data.value: Thank you for using DispHub. — Quinten (qlintenFX)

data.name: Upgrade_Body
data.value:
{0} is part of DispHub Pro.
Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks: • Every screen effect look, and saving your own • Per-app profiles that switch automatically • Schedules with smooth fades • Different settings per display • More than {1} profiles
It also supports development of DispHub.
